_note: aniq_independent_convnext_base_336_1split: aniq_independent_convnext_base_336 with validation on split 1 only (n_splits 3 -> 1) to halve the run time (about 5-6 h instead of 11-12 h); epoch and gamma selection are noisier than the 3-split baselines, so compare validation HM with that in mind. Otherwise identical: the ConvNeXt-Base independent baseline with two changes aimed at the disease network. (1) Resolution 224 -> 336 (384 px resize cache, same 0.875 crop ratio): lesions are small, and 70% of the seen images v6.3 loses to calibration keep the right crop but switch disease. (2) validation.separate_epochs: the crop and disease networks get their own epoch counts (every combination scored on validation), so a longer max_epochs (20 -> 30) cannot over-train one network to help the other. The lr schedule horizon stays 30 epochs, so epochs 1-20 follow the same learning rates as the 224 run. Compare with aniq_baseline_independent_convnext_base (val HM 60.05%, test 68.6%) and, as an ensemble member, v6.3. Judge by validation HM and unseen disease at gamma 0, not seen disease alone (a crop-specific disease model can gain seen and lose unseen).

data._note: Same splits and 333-pair protocol as the CLIP versions (generalised zero-shot).

model._note: timm ConvNeXt-Base pretrained on ImageNet-22k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k (weights downloaded by timm from Hugging Face on first use). LayerNorm rather than BatchNorm, so small physical batches with gradient accumulation are equivalent to batch 32. Stochastic depth 0.1, head dropout 0.2 (Hein's recipe).

input._note: 384 px resize cache, train random resized crop 336, test resize 384 + centre crop 336 (same ratio as 256/224), bicubic.

augmentation._note: Hein's recipe: random resized crop scale 0.5-1 (milder than the ResNet baseline's 0.25-1), flips, brightness/contrast/saturation jitter 0.2, no hue jitter (colour is diagnostic).

loss._note: Cross-entropy with label smoothing 0.1 (long-tailed, noisy labels: median 7 images per pair). For the multi-task model the two head losses are summed with equal weight.

optimizer._note: AdamW; backbone 5e-5 (half the ResNet baseline: a larger pretrained model), heads 5e-4, weight decay 0.05.

validation._note: Same validation procedure, splits and gamma grid (log-probability units) as aniq_baseline_independent_cnn; 3 splits (Hein's study used one), so epoch and gamma are chosen the same way as for every other baseline. separate_epochs: crop and disease epochs chosen independently (max_epochs^2 combinations, scored from the per-epoch validation predictions, no extra training).

training._note: As the 224 run (effective batch 32, warmup 3, cosine to 1% over a fixed 30-epoch horizon, clip 1.0) but physical batch 8 x 4 accumulation steps: at 336 px batch 16 peaks at 5.6 GiB and spills out of the 6 GB GPU (9 img/s), batch 8 peaks at 3.4 GiB (38 img/s). LayerNorm, so the smaller physical batch is equivalent. max_epochs 30 (= the schedule horizon). About 2.5-3 min per epoch, roughly 5-6 h for the whole run with one validation split.

evaluation._note: Pair score = log P(crop) + log P(disease). gamma (subtracted from seen pairs) from validation, in log-probability units.

runtime._note: 4 dataloader workers; images come from the resized cache.
